verdict.rationale: Docs mention distinct 'Development' vs 'Production' rate-limit tiers/keys (implying separate environments) and a keyless mode to try the API without an account, which together hint at a way to test without full production access, but there is no explicit sandbox environment, mock data, or isolation-from-production-data guarantee documented. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-mode documentation, confirmation that development keys don't touch live production data or billing, and any hands-on/independent corroboration.
